effective_generator_asset.asset_role: Replacement scaffold/fragment templates, not labelled active end-product retrieval records or the query set.
effective_generator_asset.dispatch: With fragments, no replacement files, enabled fingerprint search and the explicit fingerprint path, the frozen generator loads that fingerprint database. The text asset is checked against metadata.source_sha256; it is not the runtime search iterator when the fingerprint database is loaded.
effective_generator_asset.metadata_scope: 522959 is the observed row count; sorted canonical uniqueness and 39862 rejected raw lines are metadata declarations, not an independent chemical-uniqueness audit or rebuild of source filtering.
effective_generator_asset.selection: The pinned diverse policy uses fingerprint SMILES for similarity priority and a bounded hash reservoir; shortlisted candidates undergo identity/structure validation. Inventory presence is not proof of actual selection or successful molecule reconstruction.

existing_matches.counting_unit: Dataset compound records with at least one stored family/scaffold match, not unique scaffold identities, inventory matches, or query-control pairs.

existing_raw_scaffold_sample.normalization_note: Existing chemical-family and standardized Murcko-family identities ignore configured reversible protonation/tautomer, isotope and stereo distinctions; exact scoring structures remain separate. Identities were not recomputed for this disclosure.
existing_raw_scaffold_sample.parser: read_inventory: first whitespace-delimited token of each nonblank text line; sample indices are zero-based in that parsed list.
existing_raw_scaffold_sample.reason_category_rule: Exact reason text before its first colon; individual molecular inputs are omitted.
existing_raw_scaffold_sample.sample_unit: Parsed raw text record; duplicate structures can occupy separate source records.

interpretation.downstream_limit: Template/scaffold presence does not establish completed-molecule identity, generated-candidate activity, synthetic success or method superiority.
interpretation.sampling_limit: The existing raw-text sample is not a census of the effective fingerprint-library rows. Its negative matches cannot establish globally absent references or a clean holdout.
interpretation.search_space_exposure: Presence in a declared generation/search library is distinct from pretrained-model training exposure and does not by itself establish activity-label leakage.
interpretation.secondary_scope: No time/target search-space numerical results are added; this record describes the existing primary scaffold manifest only.

primary_scaffold_panel.audited_partition_scope: All dataset partitions, not only held-out active references; query membership joined separately by compound identifier.

provenance.projection_method: Read existing audit counters; join stored matches to frozen panel records by compound_id, tally partition/label and query membership, inspect pinned fingerprint metadata and array shape. No chemical normalization or model inference.

publication_scope: Aggregate counts and provenance only; no molecules, compound identifiers or individual sample records. Referenced local evidence and generator assets are not bundled with this record.
scope: Post hoc scope disclosure projected from an existing frozen primary search-space audit; no new normalization, coverage estimate or generation evaluation.
